meaning.en: Standing or operating independently of anything else.
meaning.vi: Đứng hoặc hoạt động độc lập với bất kỳ thứ gì khác.

sentences.en: Toys R Us first experimented with children's wear by opening freestanding Kids R Us stores in Paramus, New Jersey and Brooklyn, New York.

sentences.en: Sliding screens divide this area from the open-plan bathroom featuring a freestanding bathtub.

sentences.en: At each angle is a freestanding gilt bronze statuette of an allegorical female figure.
sentences.vi: Ở mỗi góc độ là một bức tượng bằng đồng mạ vàng độc lập có hình một phụ nữ ngụ ngôn.

sentences.en: It's a far cry from the freestanding arcade machines whose attributes remain relatively static.

sentences.en: This freestanding chest sits on tulip shaped feet which is a feature throughout the Victorian range from village pine.
